messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT 6549873210 - Elevated tail latency detected in router (p99) > SLO. Auto-paging oncall.

oncall-bot: livepage created: https://livepage.redwood/6549873210

Disha Patel: I'm taking this. seeing p99 spike ~1.4s across eu-west-2. p95 ~320ms. streaming stalls increasing. beginning triage.

Sam Cho: oncall handoff in 10m? I'm available to take after you.

Disha Patel: yep can hand to you after initial mitigation. quick snapshot:
- router.p95: 320ms
- router.p99: 1.4s (baseline 220-300ms)
- streaming.stall_rate: 3.2/min (norm <0.2)
- error rate: 0.6% -> 1.8% during surge

Jia Li: logs show a spike in cross-region hops for some shards. 28% of requests for hot model 'rwd-embed-v1' routed to us-west-2 from eu-west-2.

Kevin Park: that smells like a routing policy rollback or seed divergence. Any recent rollouts on routing weights?

Maria Gomez: customer telemetry: several customers report streaming bars lagging, one reported partial responses, higher client-side timeouts for long outputs.

eng-sre-bot: correlated alert: routing-sync-failure on router-set-17 at 04:12 UTC. TTL mismatch in routing table.

Disha Patel: patch of routing weights deployed ~03:58 UTC in eu-west-2 by infra-rollout. possibly partial application -> hotfanout.

Sam Cho: if it's partial, we should force sync the routing seed across the fleet and pin traffic to prefer-local for the hot model while we debug.

Disha Patel: doing force-sync now: `scripts/router-sync --set-seed 0x4f3a --region eu-west-2 --force`

ops-bot: command logged by Disha Patel at 04:18 UTC

Jia Li: confirming: after force-sync, cross-region hops dropped from 28% -> 3% in 60s. p99 decreased to ~520ms. streaming stalls down to 0.6/min.

Disha Patel: nice. still seeing taily outliers at 600-800ms on specific shards. heatmap shows hot partition on shard 42 in eu-west-2.

Sam Cho: OK plan: 1) Evacuate shard 42's hot tenants, 2) kick a redistribution for that shard, 3) rollback the routing weights rollout that touched the shard.

Kevin Park: Jia, can you start the evac? `evacuate-shard --shard 42 --region eu-west-2 --grace 30s`

Jia Li: started evac at 04:27 UTC. moving 8 top clients off shard 42.

Customer Success Bot: pinging top affected customers with templated message. Maria, please review before sending.

Maria Gomez: approved; sending now. noted that customer A saw streaming frame drops for 17 minutes.

Disha Patel: post-evac metrics: p99 back to 320-360ms, p95 300ms. streaming stalls back to baseline. estimated SLO breach window: 04:12 -> 04:30 UTC (18m).

Disha Patel: handing to Sam for remediation and postmortem. I'm going offline for meeting, will rejoin if needed.

Sam Cho: taking over. assigning postmortem to eng-sre (owner: Kevin Park). tagging infra to audit rollout pipeline.

eng-sre-bot: postmortem issue created: https://pm.redwood/IR-6549873210

Kevin Park: initial root cause hypothesis: partial routing weight rollout + routing seed divergence leading to hotfanout and cross-region misroute -> hot partition + KV cache pressure -> tail latency.

Sam Cho: immediate fixes: force-routing-sync, evacuate hot shard, pause rollout. longer term: make rollout transactional and add TTL checks to reject partial applies.

Disha Patel: thanks team. logging timeline to livepage and will capture metrics graphs.

Customer Success Bot: notifications sent to affected customers (A,B,C). CS will follow up with postmortem once complete.

Sam Cho: final notes: SEV-2, SLO breach ~18m, customer-impacting for some streaming customers. follow-ups: infra rollout hardening, add routing-seed watchdog, add shard eviction automation.

ops-bot: incident closed to livepage at 05:10 UTC pending postmortem.
